intro_jp: 駐車場。鍵を持った手。彼は大丈夫と言うが、彼女は違うと言う。

title: The Money Conversation With Brother
intro_en: Apartment. Brother to brother. Asking for help, not for the first time.
intro_jp: アパート。兄弟同士。助けを頼むのは初めてではない。

title: Asking Boss to Reduce Workload
intro_en: Office. Honest about overload. The boss is asked to listen first.
intro_jp: オフィス。仕事の重さを正直に。上司にまず聞いてもらう。

title: Returning a Sold-Out Item Demand
setting: Store; item shouldn't have been sold.
intro_en: Store. The item shouldn't have been on the shelf — but it was.
intro_jp: お店。本当は売ってはいけない商品だったが、棚に並んでいた。

title: Confronting Toxic Boss
intro_en: HR conference room. A complaint that took months to bring forward.
intro_jp: 人事の会議室。何ヶ月もかかった申し立て。

title: Disagreement About Wedding Style
intro_en: Living room. Two clear, different visions of the same wedding.
intro_jp: リビング。同じ結婚式について、二つのはっきり違う希望。

title: Letting a Long Friendship Go
intro_en: Café. Quiet acceptance of something that has already happened.
intro_jp: カフェで。すでに起きていることを、二人で静かに認める。

title: Standing Up to a Parent
intro_en: Living room of childhood. Drawing a line that should have existed earlier.
intro_jp: 子供時代を過ごしたリビング。もっと早く引くべきだった線を引く。

title: Apologising to a Whole Team
intro_en: Conference room. Whole team present. The manager opens with apology.
intro_jp: 会議室。チーム全員。マネージャーが謝罪から始める。

title: Late Rent Conversation
intro_en: Phone call. Rent is late. Explanation prepared, dignity intact.
intro_jp: 電話。家賃が遅れている。説明は準備済み、誇りは保ったまま。

title: Setting a Boundary With In-Laws
intro_en: Kitchen at the in-laws'. The spouse speaks for the first time on this.
intro_jp: 義実家の台所。配偶者が初めてこの話に口を出す。

title: Quick Coffee, Long Story
intro_en: Café. They both have ten minutes; one story will have to do.
intro_jp: カフェ。お互い十分しかない。話は一つだけ。

title: Workout Buddies on a Bad Day
setting: Walking out of the gym, both quiet.
intro_en: Walking out of the gym. Both quiet. One has had a bad day.
intro_jp: ジムを出て歩く道。二人とも静か。一人は嫌な一日だった。

title: The Friend Group Group Chat
setting: Group chat reactions to a meme.
intro_en: Group chat. Three friends, one meme, fifteen quick reactions.
intro_jp: グループチャット。友達三人、ミーム一つ、素早い反応が並ぶ。
intro_words: グループチャット,友達

title: Old Mentor Catching Up
intro_en: Café. Old mentor and former mentee. Honest career reflection.
intro_jp: カフェ。昔の指導役と元教え子。正直なキャリアの振り返り。

title: Old Photos in a Drawer
intro_en: Closet. Two sisters find a box of old photos. Stories start.
intro_jp: 押入れ。姉妹二人で古い写真の箱を見つける。話が始まる。

title: Coffee With New Father
intro_en: Café. New father with the baby napping in the carrier. Honest hour.
intro_jp: カフェ。新米のお父さん、抱っこ紐の中で赤ちゃんはお昼寝。正直な一時間。
intro_words: カフェ,お父さん,赤ちゃん

title: Voice Note to Future Child
intro_en: Voice memo recorded for a child not yet born. Two minutes of hope.
intro_jp: まだ生まれていない子供のためのボイスメモ。二分の希望。

title: Mom Sharing a Recipe Over Video
intro_en: Video call. Her kitchen, his kitchen. The dish stops being just a recipe.
intro_jp: ビデオ通話。お母さんの台所と息子の台所。レシピが思い出になる。

title: Spouse Diagnosed with Illness
intro_en: Hospital cafeteria. Long sit-down. They take turns being the strong one.
intro_jp: 病院の食堂。長い時間。強くいる役を交代しながら座る。

title: Sibling Birth Order Argument
setting: Living room; mom's side won't settle it.
intro_en: Living room. Reopening the argument about who broke the lamp in 1998.
intro_jp: リビング。1998年にランプを壊したのは誰か、また蒸し返す。

title: Old Friend's Death Reaction
intro_en: Apartment. News of an old friend's death. They sit, they remember.
intro_jp: アパート。昔の友達の訃報。二人で座って思い出す。

title: Quitting a Toxic Friendship Group
intro_en: Park, evening. Explaining why he is stepping back from the group.
intro_jp: 夕方の公園。あのグループから少し離れる理由を話す。

title: Returning to Hometown
intro_en: Café in the old hometown. Smaller than memory, brighter than expected.
intro_jp: 地元のカフェ。記憶より小さく、思ったより明るい。

title: Career Pivot Conversation
intro_en: Bar. Weighing whether to leave the industry entirely.
intro_jp: バーで。業界から離れるかどうかを真剣に考える。

title: New Year's Eve Phone Call
intro_en: Phone call right before midnight. A few honest sentences before the bell.
intro_jp: 深夜十二時の少し前の電話。鐘が鳴る前に正直な数行。

title: First Day at the New Job
intro_en: Office tour. First day at the new job. Trying to remember every name.
intro_jp: オフィス見学。新しい職場の初日。名前を全部覚えようと頑張る。
